doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Playing string bass, in Chicago
summary: He says he played string bass in parade bands only up north, in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you play with parade bands?
I have not. But I have up north, though, but not down south. What did you play?

How'd you carry it? You see, you put the strap around you. And then you put the strap around you and you wear a certain way it fits that bass, you see. And people never see nothing like that down here, but we did it up north.
Oh, well, you've been around, huh?
I've been around pretty much. Pretty much. I've been around pretty much.
